articles.summary: SAN JOSE, Calif., Oct. 8, 2024 /PRNewswire/ -- 42Q, a Sanmina division, a leading provider of cloud-based Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), announces Sanmina Announces the Launch of 42Q Connected Manufacturing, Real-Time Visibility to Distributed Manufacturing Immediately Available.
